    • waitUntilFinished

      public PbcsJobStatus waitUntilFinished() throws InterruptedException
      Description copied from interface: PbcsJobStatus
      Convenience method to wait (and poll) until the job is finished, one way or the other. This method calls PbcsJobStatus.waitUntilFinished(long, TimeUnit) using the PbcsJobStatus.DEFAULT_CHECK_INTERVAL_MILLIS value.
      Specified by:
      waitUntilFinished in interface PbcsJobStatus
      Returns:
      returns the most recent refresh of this job (could/should be different from original instance if it wasn't already complete)
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if an interruption occurs

    • waitUntilFinished

      public PbcsJobStatus waitUntilFinished(long checkInterval, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException
      Description copied from interface: PbcsJobStatus
      Wait until job is finished (success or failure). This mechanism serves mostly a quick convenience that just loops until the job is finished. If you are concerned that the task might be waiting for a long time, you may be better served refreshing the status yourself with the PbcsJobStatus.refresh() method used inside an Executor, in order to avoid busy waiting the thread.
      Specified by:
      waitUntilFinished in interface PbcsJobStatus
      Parameters:
      checkInterval - how often to poll for a job update
      unit - the time unit for the check interval
      Returns:
      returns the most recent refresh of this job (could/should be different from original instance if it wasn't already complete)
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if an interruption occurs
